_comment: Joist / rafter systems for floors and roofs ('use': 'joists' keeps them out of MCFraming's wall list). A floor or roof framing layer says "system": "wood" | "metal"; the engine looks for '<system>_joists' first, so swapping wood <-> metal is the same one-line option as for walls. family: member profile family (picked by the layer thickness, or the layer's 'joist' / 'rafter' option names one); track_family: metal rim / sub-fascia track; rim_plies: wood rim joist plies; blocking_spacing: max distance between blocking / bridging rows (0 = none); strap: metal bridging strap profile; ridge_family: ridge member family (deeper than the rafter). max_span: typical maximum joist span per profile (floor, 40 psf live, 16" o.c.) - only used for a warning. names: member labels written to parts.

wood_joists.label: Wood joists / rafters (sawn lumber or I-joists)

metal_joists.label: Cold-formed steel C-joists / rafters in joist track
